attended a last-minute appointment today and left feeling extremely upset and unheard.

From the start, the doctor was unwelcoming, rude, and dismissive. I explained that I have been experiencing continuous bleeding for two months following a miscarriage and that I had been advised not to ignore these symptoms and to seek medical attention promptly.

Instead of being listened to, my concerns were minimised. I was told that women have bled for years and questioned as to why I was complaining. When I asked if there was anything that could be done to help, I was told that an ambulance could be called “if it feels like I’m dying.”

I was not given the opportunity to fully explain my symptoms, including concerns about a possible infection and difficulties going to the toilet. I was repeatedly interrupted and spoken to in a raised and aggressive manner. I was instructed to take tablets that I have not yet received and to complete blood tests, which I did today.

I left the appointment feeling distressed, unsupported, and still in pain. I went home and cried. This was a very disappointing experience at a time when I was already physically and emotionally vulnerable. I hope this feedback is taken seriously so that other patients are treated with more empathy and
